correctness.rationale: Reconstructed intrinsic graph-metric Čech scale r=3: for every edge uv, the union N1[u]∪N1[v] is a maximal simplex of 8 vertices; 32 edges yield 32 distinct facets and exactly 3944 nonempty faces with f=(16,112,448,1016,1264,800,256,32). Independent mod-2 full chain ranks (15,97,351,664,576,224,32) give reduced β3=1,β4=24 over F2 and bound rational ranks above; reduced Euler 23 leaves rational possibilities (0,23) or (1,24). Enumerated every one of 384 signed coordinate permutations; for every simplex fixed setwise, computed signed reduced simplicial Lefschetz term and found its 20 class values as claimed. The virtual character c has inner product −1 against determinant, impossible if β3=0 and c is an honest degree-4 character. Hence β3=1, χ3=det and χ4=c+det. Independently tested the orthogonal 20 bipartition irreducible characters and found exactly four multiplicity-one constituents V_(2),(2), V_(2),(1,1), V_(3),(1), V_(2,1),(1), dimensions 6+6+4+8=24. The determinant module and four other modules have no fixed full-group vectors. Finite group and all simplex enumeration are exhaustive, not sampling; claim is rational representation, not integral equivariant equivalence.
